18bdee973309a6f3.description: About AbbVie AbbVie is dedicated to discovering and delivering innovative medicines and solutions that address serious health issues and future medical challenges. The company aims to make a significant impact on people's lives across therapeutic areas such as immunology, oncology, and neuroscience, in addition to products and services within its Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. The Role AbbVie is seeking a Senior Product Specialist Immunology to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. The specialist will be responsible for driving sales performance and achieving brand objectives within the immunology therapeutic area. Key Responsibilities Deliver sales performance, brand KPIs, financial targets, and marketing objectives to meet or exceed established goals. Create pre-call plans using SMART objectives and conduct post-call evaluations to continuously enhance sales performance. Effectively manage objections, misunderstandings, and concerns, consistently securing logical calls to action on every sales call. Proactively and continuously address customer needs, expectations, and challenges to build trusted relationships and achieve mutually beneficial agreements. Develop and execute a call plan that meets set metrics and optimizes coverage and frequency to key customers, maximizing access and sales opportunities. Continuously build understanding of customer needs, market landscape, competitors, market dynamics, accounts, disease states, products, clinical data, and sales expertise. Share this market intelligence with the in-field team, brand team, and sales manager to ensure alignment and optimize brand strategy. Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with assigned healthcare providers and identify, develop, and maintain relationships with disease state experts and advocates to maximize brand performance. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field. Location and Work Type This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

18f0dba6a1b5f3a2.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Government Relations Officer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is integral to the Human Resources Department, focusing on both government relations activities and HR operations. The position involves executing departmental projects, providing administrative and operational support, and ensuring the efficient and professional execution of daily activities. The officer will also support and coordinate daily HR operations, implement HR policies and procedures, and provide professional HR services to employees and management. The role encompasses managing employee records, recruitment, onboarding, attendance, payroll coordination, employee relations, leave administration, government documentation, and employee separation procedures. The Government Relations Officer ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies and applicable labor regulations, contributing to a positive and productive work environment. Key Responsibilities Represent the hotel before ministries and government authorities as assigned. Manage and process transactions through various government platforms and portals, including GOSI, Balady, Civil Defense (Salama), Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Tourism, ZATCA, and Qiwa. Prepare forms, spreadsheets, reports, and presentations using Microsoft Office applications. Perform fieldwork assignments, including evening and night duties when required. Process municipal permits, medical examinations, and coordinate agreements with hospitals. Draft official letters and correspondence. Submit weekly reports on assigned tasks and completed activities. Keep management informed of new government regulations, systems, and updates. Respond to emails and prepare correspondence on behalf of the department. Prepare weekly and monthly reports for the Human Resources Manager. Support various administrative requests and maintain a clean, organized, and professional work environment. Human Resources Operations Handle employee inquiries, concerns, and requests professionally, supporting employee engagement and positive employee relations. Coordinate recruitment activities, interviews, and job offers, preparing employment documents and managing the onboarding process. Review and verify monthly attendance records and payroll inputs, coordinating with the Finance Department for accurate salary processing. Monitor employee attendance, absences, overtime, and leave balances, processing corrections and requests. Maintain and update employee files and HR records, preparing employment certificates and other HR documents. Coordinate employee-related government transactions, following up on work permits, visas, medical insurance, and residency requirements. Support performance appraisal processes and coordinate employee training and development activities. Ensure HR practices comply with company policies and applicable labor regulations, communicating policies to employees. Prepare and review final settlement calculations, coordinating employee clearance and exit procedures. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of previous experience in Government Relations or a similar role. Previous experience in Human Resources, preferably within the hospitality industry. Good knowledge of HR operations, payroll, attendance, and employee relations. Familiarity with HR systems and Microsoft Office applications. Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information. Work Environment The role requires availability to work within the hotel, outside the hotel, or at any Conrad Riyadh or Hilton property when required. Compliance with emergency procedures and safety instructions is essential. The officer will build and maintain effective working relationships with departments, team members, and guests.

18280f890aa26ce0.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Operational Readiness - AA9 to lead the end-to-end handover process for District ICT Infrastructure services. This full-time role focuses on transitioning services from delivery into live operations, ensuring all operational onboarding, documentation, support contracts, and knowledge transfer are completed to the required standards before service commencement. Key Responsibilities Define and manage the handover governance framework for District ICT systems, ensuring consistent application across systems, vendors, and projects. Oversee the onboarding of services into ICC, ServiceNow, and related operational support processes, confirming readiness for go-live. Ensure complete documentation packs, SOPs, and technical records are provided by delivery teams, and lead knowledge transfer to BAU teams. Manage support contract registration, warranty coverage transition, and ensure contractual support obligations are reflected in the live support model. Maintain a consolidated view of handover readiness, open risks, and unresolved actions, chairing reviews and providing clear recommendations to management. Drive the closure of post-handover stabilization issues requiring formal follow-up. Required Competencies Expertise in designing handover governance and applying it consistently across diverse systems, vendors, and projects. Proven experience in service transition and operational onboarding. Ability to plan knowledge transfer and develop operational competency within teams. Commercial awareness regarding support contracts, warranties, and third-party obligations. Capability for clear risk reporting, decisive escalation, and confident chairing of reviews. Demonstrated experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking, and structured cabling. Interactions and Engagement This role involves significant interaction with various stakeholders, including delivery teams and system integrators for handover deliverables, ICC and BAU operations teams for onboarding and day-one support, and ServiceNow, ITAM, and CMDB owners for service records and tool configuration. Engagement also extends to vendors, OEMs, third-party support providers for contracts and escalation commitments, procurement and contracts teams for support obligations, and senior management for readiness recommendations and escalations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in IT or OT operations, with at least 4 years in service or relationship management. A sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity, and cybersecurity principles. Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change, and escalation management practices. Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices, and governance in multi-party environments. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1817848ac39052ca.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an HVAC Technician to join their team in Riyadh and Ad Dir'iyah. This full-time role involves inspecting, repairing, and maintaining HVAC, air quality control, and refrigeration equipment, ensuring optimal property temperature and efficient energy usage. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Inspect, repair, and maintain HVAC, air quality control, and refrigeration equipment. Conduct daily inspections of the mechanical plant and monitor property temperature. Monitor and analyze energy and utilities usage, and calibrate controls, gauges, and meters. Assemble, install, test, repair, and maintain electrical systems or electronic wiring. Assemble, install, and maintain pipe assemblies, fittings, and valves. Perform routine pool and spa maintenance. Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures, reporting maintenance problems, hazards, accidents, or injuries. Maintain a professional appearance, confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome guests according to company standards and address service needs. Communicate professionally with colleagues and maintain positive working relationships. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, and recommend improvements for efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, or cost-savings. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Physical Requirements Ability to reach overhead and below the knees. Capability to move in confined or elevated spaces, and over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Ability to move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or a ladder. Capacity to grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Ability to assist with moving, lifting, carrying, and placing objects weighing in excess of 100 pounds. Capability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. About the Team The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, part of Marriott International, operates over 120 properties in more than 35 countries. With a history spanning over 100 years, the brand focuses on delivering authentic experiences and creating lasting memories for luxury travelers. Each property reflects its locale's cultural charms and treasures. The team values individuals who appreciate evocative storytelling, possess a passion for local heritage, and are committed to delivering genuine, personalized hospitality.

18fb13d56e2603ea.description: About Almarai Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in MENA. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in the MENA region and holds a market leadership position across its categories in GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. With over five decades of sustainable growth, Almarai has consistently delivered nutritious products, guided by its principle: “Quality you can trust.” Almarai’s product portfolio has expanded beyond dairy to include juices and beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water. These products are offered under more than 20 brands, including Almarai, L’usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, Farm’s Select, Ice Leaf, Almira, Seama, Oska, IVAL, Almara Pro, Premier Chef, and Bakemart. The company currently employs over 43,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. The Role of Senior Engineering Manager Almarai is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager for a full-time position in Rabigh. This role is central to maintaining company assets through the implementation of a total preventative maintenance system. The objective is to ensure complete operational availability for all departments as required by business needs. The Senior Engineering Manager will ensure that all plant and equipment remain in optimal condition, adhering to established standards and budget provisions. Key Responsibilities Implement and manage a total preventative maintenance system to ensure operational availability across all departments. Comply with agreed standards, budget allocations, and provisions set by the business. Meet management performance targets established by the business. Ensure all plant and equipment are maintained in optimal condition at all times. Ensure compliance with all relevant standards and cost controls. Provide adequate skills, labor, and guidance across all departments to meet business requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 7-10 years of relevant experience. Compensation and Benefits Almarai offers a competitive remuneration package, generous leave, and medical coverage. Additional benefits include a discretionary bonus, along with opportunities for training and development.

1875b3f5389710a5.description: About the Role Synmatch AI's client, a European group specializing in the design and manufacture of electrical test, measurement, and monitoring equipment, is seeking a Technical Sales Manager for the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region. This full-time, permanent position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires at least 60% travel across the MEA region. The role focuses on driving demand generation, managing distribution partner relationships, and leading technical sales activities, particularly in power quality for utilities, healthcare, and renewable energy sectors, with Saudi Arabia as a priority market. The compensation for this role is SAR 365,000-470,000 gross/year. Key Responsibilities Acquire new accounts through market research, referrals, networking, and prospecting activities (phone, email, site visits with partners). Organize seminars, workshops, webinars, and exhibitions to generate leads and ensure product inclusion in consultant and end-user specifications before tenders. Build and maintain long-term relationships with distribution partners and key end-users, agreeing on joint account plans and identifying gaps in partner coverage. Coordinate local calibration and repair services with authorized service partners. Present brands, conduct demonstrations, site measurements, and trials, and train partner sales and service teams. Lead new product introductions in the region and serve as the technical liaison between partners and product teams in Germany, Switzerland, the UK, and the US. Prepare technical and commercial offers with partners and the back office, including tender responses and compliance statements. Lead negotiations on prices, discounts, and delivery terms for major opportunities, coordinating with technical, logistics, and accounting teams. Monitor market trends and competitor activity across the region, sharing customer feedback and reasons for lost deals with sales management and product teams. Manage the annual order target for the region, with performance measured by order intake, qualified pipeline, new opportunity metrics, forecast accuracy, partner orders, event-generated leads, tenders, and partner staff training. Maintain up-to-date customer, partner, and opportunity data in CRM, submit monthly forecasts and activity reports, and participate in regular sales meetings. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering. At least 10 years of experience in technical sales of test and measurement or power equipment. Strong practical knowledge of power quality standards: IEC 61000-4-30, EN 50160, and IEEE 519. Proven track record of selling through distributors and achieving revenue targets. Work experience in Saudi Arabia and the wider MEA region. Proficiency in CRM and office applications. Required Skills Ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to engineers, buyers, and management. Confidence in commercial discussions and a focus on closing deals. Strong self-motivation, with the ability to work independently and manage time and travel effectively. Customer-focused approach, prioritizing customer needs and providing relevant recommendations. Flexibility to adapt to diverse markets, cultures, and customer types. Desirable Attributes Experience in utilities (distribution networks, substations, or power quality monitoring projects), healthcare (electrical safety testing to IEC 62353 and IEC 60601-1), or renewable energy (solar PV testing to IEC 62446-1, or work with EPCs and developers). Established network with utilities, EPC contractors, and consultants in Saudi Arabia. Experience with Saudi tenders and vendor registration processes. Familiarity with digital sales tools and social selling techniques. Possession of a valid Saudi driving license. Work Environment This role is approximately 60% technical and 40% commercial, reporting directly to the Director of Regional Sales MEA. Employment will be managed through WorkMotion, acting as the Employer of Record to handle local contracts, payroll, and benefits. The position requires significant travel, approximately 60% of the time, across the MEA region.

189266ee0d7cc2eb.job_title: Head of Research and Academic Safety
189266ee0d7cc2eb.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
189266ee0d7cc2eb.description: About King Abdullah University of Science and Technology King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) operates a 36 km2 suburban campus on the Red Sea, featuring a residential city for over 7,000 residents, a university campus with million ft2 of modern research laboratories, and a research park hosting various local and global research centers. In addition to the main campus, marine and land-based field research is conducted across the country and in other international locations. Role Summary The Head, Research & Academic Safety, will lead a high-performing team of professional managers, leads, and specialists. This full-time role focuses on strengthening the safety culture within the organization's research environment, encompassing research and teaching laboratories, as well as field research. The incumbent acts as KAUST's lead for all research safety matters, responsible for the development, implementation, and administration of the research safety program. This position requires close collaboration with direct reports, other Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) teams, and stakeholders across KAUST to deliver comprehensive services. The role ensures the implementation of the highest HSE professional standards to meet the needs of a high-performing research community, utilizing innovative approaches to educate, support, and hold the community accountable for best practice research safety processes. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain close working relationships with Principal Investigators and their research teams to understand their work and associated hazards, promoting a strong safety culture. Mentor team members to foster collaboration, best practices, a strong safety culture, and compliance. Develop assessment, inspection, monitoring, and other oversight processes to provide independent assurance to KAUST senior leadership regarding safe university operations. Ensure near misses and incidents are appropriately investigated by the HSE team, lab safety representatives, and research managers, and that research managers implement corrective actions. Establish strong and collaborative working relationships with support staff, carriers, and vendors to create effective solutions for research safety challenges. Collaborate with Risk Management and other stakeholder departments to maintain the KAUST Research and Academic Risk Register and a monitoring program for control measure verification. Create and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for HSE practices and results for both KAUST and individual departments. Ensure appropriate escalation of safety issues to senior leadership and other departments if they cannot be addressed by the incumbent and their team. Oversee contractor compliance with research safety programs and requirements for high-risk/high-impact activities, and general compliance with KAUST Policies and Procedures. Maintain department's data management systems and recommend improvements for accuracy and efficiency, developing ways to use KPIs as effective management tools to foster a strong safety culture. Required Qualifications and Skills Strong academic understanding of complex and high-risk research activities and their associated hazards. In-depth knowledge of best practice HSE principles as applied to cutting-edge research activities. Good knowledge of and ability to read and interpret international codes and regulations. Ability to present information to management and groups in a succinct manner. Proven ability to function effectively at a management level and form good working relationships with faculty, research managers, and their counterparts. Knowledge of HSE and project management best practices. Ability to interact with a diverse group of individuals. Ability to produce, interpret, and assess complex reports. Proven team leadership skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, operating within a dynamic research and academic setting that includes laboratories and field research locations.

1897a46b36294156.description: About the Role GDC Middle East (الشركة السعودية لتهيئة وصيانة الطائرات) is seeking an ELT Instructor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves teaching English language and American culture to MNG personnel, supporting their qualification goals. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to equip MNG personnel with the necessary English language proficiency and cultural understanding to achieve their mission objectives. The instructor will deliver effective language instruction and provide guidance to students throughout their learning journey. Key Responsibilities Deliver instruction effectively based on established lesson plans and course objectives. Provide tactical correction and feedback to students, ensuring positive reinforcement. Achieve qualification standards across all assigned functional areas. Ensure that counseling, assessments, evaluations, and recommendations are appropriate, educationally sound, compliant with organizational directives, and completed promptly. Thoroughly evaluate training and testing materials for adequacy, suitability, and effectiveness. Mentor and train new personnel as directed, adhering to established training plans and schedules. Maintain an appropriate and positive affective environment, controlling voice modulation, pace of instruction, and ensuring structure and vocabulary usage are consistent with students’ proficiency levels and subject matter. Effectively manage inappropriate student behavior. Keep the supervisor informed of any actual or potential student problems in a timely manner. Accurately monitor and update all student records, including counseling and testing forms. Disseminate administrative information accurately and promptly. Complete all training requirements in compliance with company policies and procedures. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 2-5 years of experience in English language instruction or a related field. A strong understanding of effective instructional delivery and student assessment is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the ELT Instructor will work with MNG personnel in a structured educational setting. The role requires adherence to company policies and procedures, ensuring a consistent and professional learning environment.

189f8fca2779dece.description: About the Role Plat4mation is seeking an Engineer Technician to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery and implementation of ServiceNow solutions for clients across various industries. The Engineer Technician will work with experienced consultants, project teams, and client stakeholders to configure, test, document, and support ServiceNow applications, contributing to successful project delivery. Role Context This position is suitable for individuals with 0-1 year of experience who are interested in developing a career in ServiceNow consulting, enterprise software implementation, digital transformation, and project delivery. The role provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in a professional services environment. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and configuration of ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements. Assist in configuring ServiceNow applications, workflows, forms, catalogs, and platform capabilities. Participate in testing, issue resolution, and solution validation activities. Support requirements gathering, documentation, and project deliverables. Collaborate with consultants, developers, project managers, and client stakeholders throughout project lifecycles. Assist with system administration, data preparation, deployment activities, and user support. Participate in project workshops, meetings, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Requesting an accommodation will not negatively affect an application.

18fb2eef74810c57.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مبيت الحجاز الذهبية للسفر و السياحة عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0-1 سنة ويعمل بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي التسويق مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان فعالية الأنشطة التسويقية للشركة، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتجات لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويقها. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج المناسبة، واختيار قنوات التوزيع الفعالة، وتقييم فاعلية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير الاستراتيجيات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والأسعار. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة. طبيعة العمل يتضمن الدور إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذ الخطط التسويقية وتقييمها بشكل مستمر. يتطلب الدور القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعامل مع البيانات التسويقية بدقة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة مبيت الحجاز الذهبية للسفر و السياحة، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

1827354e7a6a2c09.description: About GEDU Global Education GEDU Global Education is seeking a Business Development Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position designed to support the growth and operational efficiency of the business. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to support the development of GEDU's business, including its people, processes, technologies, and data. The manager will ensure revenue targets are met, service quality is maintained and continually improved, and operational efficiency is maximized. Key Responsibilities Identify and establish partnerships with new potential student recruitment agencies and other educational or training providers. Actively assist the team in achieving student recruitment targets for each intake. Develop and sustain solid relationships with company stakeholders, recruiting partners, and customers. Analyze customer feedback data to assess satisfaction with company products and services. Support programme management team members to maximize enrolment. Attend business meetings and provide regular training to new recruiting partners. Provide insights for product development and competitive positioning. Analyze financial data and develop effective strategies to reduce business costs and increase company profits. Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities. Collaborate with company executives to determine the most viable and cost-effective approach for pursuing new business opportunities. Meet with potential partners to present company offerings and negotiate business deals. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in business development, preferably within the education sector. Commitment and Values The Business Development Manager is expected to demonstrate commitment to GEDU's values and regulations, including its equal opportunities policy. This includes contributing to GEDU’s Social, Economic, and Environmental responsibilities, minimizing environmental impact, and actively supporting the company’s Environmental Policy. Furthermore, the role requires adherence to Health and Safety responsibilities to ensure a safe and secure working environment for staff, students, and visitors. 18cb862d1e5bd9d9.description: About Bechtel Corporation and the Project Bechtel Corporation, established in 1898, has a long history of completing projects across 160 countries, focusing on infrastructure, energy, and vital services. Ensure procedural compliance, material control, and complete and thorough documentation of inspections for completed work. Direct or perform preparation of quantity listings of field-purchased material and equipment and initiate requisitions for field material purchases. Support the preparation of construction drawings and schedules, design of temporary construction facilities, and ensure the preparation of as-built drawings and other job plans. Support the planning and delivery of construction materials and equipment, ensuring proper warehousing and storage for environmental protection. 18b32f18f8129bf8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إن إي إس جلوبال العربية عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تنظيم الأعمال الإدارية اليومية، وتنسيق المواعيد والاجتماعات، وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى إدارة البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقًا لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، وطباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة البريد والمواعيد والملفات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية قوية. القدرة على استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية (مثل Microsoft Office). الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إنجاز المهام الإدارية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الإداري اللازم. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية، ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة إن إي إس جلوبال العربية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

18f602ad36b4bb3b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة روتيني اليومي عن بائع مستحضرات وأدوات تجميل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم مجموعة متنوعة من مستحضرات العناية وأدوات التجميل للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات وأسعارها. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة أيضاً مسؤوليات إدارة المدفوعات والمخزون لضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من مستحضرات العناية وأدوات التجميل للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة حول المستحضرات وأدوات التجميل، بما في ذلك الأسعار والميزات. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام لضمان توفر المنتجات، والحفاظ على ترتيب وتنظيم المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء للمنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. تولي عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بكفاءة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع مستحضرات التجميل أو العناية الشخصية. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على شرح تفاصيل المنتجات بوضوح. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتقديم أفضل تجربة للعملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات خدمة العملاء. القدرة على إدارة المخزون. مهارات التعامل مع المدفوعات. الالتزام بسياسات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

18b04051d9ceb20d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الافق لتقنية المعلومات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تطوير العلاقات مع العملاء واستقطاب فرص مبيعات جديدة لتعزيز نمو الشركة في قطاع تقنية المعلومات. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات والخدمات التقنية، وتقديم عروض البيع مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع، وتحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المسؤوليات الأساسية استقطاب عملاء جدد وتعريفهم بحلول الشركة وخدماتها التقنية المتنوعة. متابعة العملاء المحتملين وبناء علاقات مهنية قوية ومستدامة معهم. التفاوض مع العملاء ومتابعة الفرص البيعية لتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. تحديد واستهداف العملاء والجهات المحتملة التي يمكن أن تستفيد من منتجات وخدمات الشركة، والبحث عن فرص بيع جديدة من خلال التواصل المباشر ومتابعة احتياجات السوق. تجهيز العروض التجارية والتسويقية للعملاء بالتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية، وتوضيح تفاصيل المنتجات والخدمات والأسعار المعتمدة والمزايا المقدمة، ومتابعة ملاحظات العملاء بشأنها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع تقنية المعلومات. القدرة على بناء وتطوير علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تفاوض وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وتتطلب الوظيفة التفرغ الكامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

18ce2476998f71a1.description: تعلن شركة بن داوود القابضة عن توفر فرص وظيفية بمسمى كاشير للعمل في فروع بن داوود والدانوب مدينة الرياض . المهام الوظيفية: استقبال العملاء وإنهاء عمليات الدفع. التعامل مع أجهزة نقاط البيع POS. التأكد من دقة المبالغ والفواتير. تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الفرع. المتطلبات: سعودي/سعودية. العمر 18 سنة فأعلى. المؤهل الدراسي أقل من البكالوريوس. إجادة التعامل مع الأرقام بالعربي والإنجليزي. يفضل وجود خبرة سابقة في الكاشير أو نقاط البيع POS. يشترط وجود كرت بلديه ساري او الاستعداد لاستخراج الشهادة الصحية. الراتب : 5000 ريال ساعات العمل: 9 ساعات يوميًا تشمل ساعة راحة. أيام العمل: 5 أيام عمل + يومين راحة أسبوعيًا. مكان العمل: فروع بن داوود والدانوب حسب الفروع والاحتياج.

1844b8499fbba757.description: About the Role Tecnimont is seeking a Construction Insulation and Painting Supervisor to join its team in Jubail, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves directing subcontractor activities related to insulation and painting, ensuring that construction works align with erection schedules, project documents, and budget constraints, while adhering to quality and safety procedures and subcontract terms. Key Responsibilities Review supplier material and technical documentation delivery schedules to ensure alignment with construction timelines and contractual commitments before work commences. Control and approve Method Statements submitted by subcontractors, verifying their correct application on-site. Ensure the implementation of all HSE procedures and standards within assigned areas and activities, including those of subcontractors. Participate directly in site HSE activities as defined by the Site HSE plan and related procedures for this position. Monitor adherence to schedules and initiate actions to recover any delays. Verify the adequacy of equipment and manpower deployed by subcontractors, and confirm that works conform to design documents, safety regulations, and specified quality levels. Perform inspections and sign necessary certificates in accordance with Site Inspection Plans. Prepare non-conformity registers for each subcontractor and coordinate the resolution of non-conformities. 182b1fe7235b557a.description: إعلان وظيفة: محاسب زبائن (كاشير) – مطعم في الرياض يعلن أحد المطاعم بمدينة الرياض في حي العريجاء عن حاجته إلى محاسب زبائن (كاشير) يتمتع بالمهارة والاحترافية في خدمة العملاء. المتطلبات: إتقان استخدام أنظمة نقاط البيع (POS). القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بلباقة واحترافية. سرعة ودقة في إتمام عمليات البيع والدفع. المهام الرئيسية: استقبال المدفوعات النقدية والإلكترونية. إعداد التقارير اليومية الخاصة بالمبيعات. إدارة صندوق النقد وضمان سلامة العمليات المالية. الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل.

1868533e401d64b5.description: About Bristol Myers Squibb At Bristol Myers Squibb, the company's culture is centered on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines to address serious diseases. The organization offers work that transforms patient lives and supports career growth within an inclusive environment that values wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. Role Overview The Field Access Manager - MOH will be based in Riyadh, Jeddah, or Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and will report to the Director – Market Access and Government Affairs, Saudi Arabia & Gulf Countries. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on managing relationships with clinical pharmacies in hospitals and institutions, NUPCO, and Central Medical Supplies at the Ministry of Health (MoH). The manager will facilitate the execution of NUPCO contracts at the account level, including quantity calculations, tender awards, delivery schedules, purchase order preparation, and consumption monitoring. The role also involves monitoring product stock levels across the entire supply chain in Saudi Arabia, encompassing distributors, hospitals, institutions, MoH, and the private sector. Key Responsibilities Implement market access plans and optimize Months of Inventory (MOI) for all SKUs across accounts, institutions, and distributors, collaborating with Strategic Access, Finance, Supply Chain, and distributors. Lead the tenders taskforce with all franchise teams on a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly basis. Assist in analyzing government policies and strategies related to medicine access, Health Economic Assessment policies, and pharmaceutical spending trends, in cooperation with Market Access Lead and Government Affairs Regional/Global Leads. Maintain regular interactions with cross-functional BMS teams (Franchise Teams, Access and Govt. Affairs, Medical, Regulatory), distributors, pharmacy, planning, and purchasing departments at institutions and Health Clusters, Central Medical Supplies, regional ministry branches at MoH, NUPCO, and key private accounts. Ensure full compliance with laws, regulations, and BMS Standards of Business Conduct and Ethics. Establish and maintain close relationships with distributors, institutions, clusters, NUPCO, and MoH. Participate in strategic access discussions and assist in developing strategic access plans for all products. Facilitate the timely completion and execution of NUPCO awards and contracts, including account purchase order issuance. Monitor market/account needs, monthly consumption, and stock levels. Serve as the main point of contact for any supply or stock-related issues at the account level. Lead on-ground efforts to implement strategic access plans and ensure enlistment timelines are met. Regularly update cross-functional teams on Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committees’ status and schedule. Coach Therapeutic Area Partners (TAPs) on the process of Special Patient Requests (SPRs) and enlistment across all accounts and institutions in Saudi Arabia. Aid in developing monitoring dashboards and ensure timely data feeding. Conduct regular joint visits with TAPs to resolve access-related issues. Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the healthcare environment, trends, and emerging segments, proposing strategies to establish BMS as a partner of choice. Communicate changes concerning the environment and interact with Franchise Teams to drive competitive advantage. Required Qualifications and Skills 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated communication and negotiation skills. Work Environment and Travel This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Jeddah, or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires regular travel to fulfill responsibilities across various accounts and institutions.

1869890eb24e6825.description: About the Role HCLTech is seeking a Senior Design Lead - Manufacturing Process to oversee construction activities across five main Logistic Park sites. 18a4937d14f495e7.description: About HSBC Saudi Arabia HSBC Saudi Arabia provides investment banking services to a broad range of corporate and institutional clients across both private and government sectors. This includes public companies, private companies and establishments, funds, government agencies, and family businesses and offices. Role Purpose The Senior Manager NonFinancial Risk Securities Services is a senior management role responsible for overseeing and executing key activities within the Risk and Control Framework in Securities Services (SSV). This full-time position, located in Al Dar Al Baida District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves coordinating, advising, and providing independent challenge and assessment for all risk governance, reporting, and data quality activities undertaken by the Non-Financial Risk (NFR) Function or SSV Business/Risk Owners, in line with the NFRO model/FIM. Key Responsibilities Understand and interpret NFR requirements and changes, providing ongoing assurance and reporting on global adherence, in collaboration with MENA NFR teams and 2LOD stakeholders. Manage and oversee the cascade and adoption of FIM Policy Framework changes. Oversee, support, and deliver fit-for-purpose risk governance arrangements and related reporting. Assist the NFR function in designing and delivering a consistent risk-based assurance and monitoring program, including substantive control testing (ICMP), KRI, and Thematic Reviews. Ensure the SSV Risk & Control Assessment (RCA) is dynamically maintained based on relevant risk triggers. Support risk and control-related activities, including liaison with Internal/External Audit and Regulatory Authorities. Act as a senior manager within the HBSA SSV NFR function, driving management, coordination, and execution of risk management activities across SSV. Maintain relationships with 2nd and 3rd line of defense risk functions and interact regularly with MSS and OPS Risk colleagues. Oversee the effective monitoring of risks, services, and processes against agreed group/divisional standards and external requirements. Ensure the risk governance framework is clear, fit for purpose, and executed as defined, with adequate and effective escalation paths. Support NFR and SSV Senior Management in ensuring appropriate risk and control structures are in place and highlighted risks are managed. Play a key role in communication across SSV, MSS, OPS Risk, Global Functions, and DBS regarding the Risk and Control Agenda. Provide consistent internal and external benchmarking where appropriate. Ensure detailed understanding, communication, and execution of a robust SSV risk management framework. Support line management and the NFR Leadership Team in driving the risk agenda across SSV. Attend Risk & Control related committees/forums as required, ensuring critical SSV risks and issues are covered. Regularly review business risk management policies, operating processes, and activities. Assist the NFR function in minimizing disruption by ensuring business continuity. Implement oversight and assurance of the risk and control framework to manage operational and other risks effectively. Ensure the business inherent risk profile and related issues are understood, and appropriate actions are in place to manage residual risk within appetite. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to act as a senior manager, driving coordination and execution of risk management activities. Experience in maintaining relationships with 2nd and 3rd line of defense risk functions. Understanding of risk governance frameworks and escalation paths. Ability to provide technical leadership and support technical excellence. Challenges of the Role Overseeing and assuring a diverse and complex risk, control, and regulatory environment that is continuously evolving. Staying current with external developments in global regulation, market trends, and competitor activity. Operating within a global business across 38 countries, meeting Group standards while understanding the commercial realities of SSV's institutional client base. Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to shape a sustainable future for SSV. Challenging the risk profile with peers across MSS and relevant Global Functions, balancing risk reward and commercial benefit. Internal Controls and Compliance The jobholder will adhere to internal controls by following all relevant procedures, maintaining appropriate records, and implementing internal and external audit points, including those raised by external regulators. Compliance with HBSA Compliance Policies will be achieved by containing compliance risk in liaison with the HBSA Heads of Compliance (Regulatory and Financial Crime). This includes adhering to all relevant processes/procedures and liaising with the Compliance department on new business initiatives. The role also involves ensuring adequate resources and training are in place to meet compliance requirements and fostering a compliance culture.

182a5a37416ae3ab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التشييد الشرقي للمقاولات عن مهندس إلكترونيات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة وإصلاح الأجهزة والأنظمة الإلكترونية، مع التركيز على ضمان كفاءة وسلامة التشغيل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة وإصلاح الأجهزة والأنظمة الإلكترونية. فحص الدوائر والمكونات الإلكترونية وتشخيص الأعطال الفنية. إصلاح واستبدال القطع والمكونات التالفة لضمان استمرارية العمل. إجراء الاختبارات الفنية اللازمة للتأكد من كفاءة الأجهزة وسلامة تشغيلها. صيانة لوحات التحكم والدوائر الإلكترونية بشكل دوري. متابعة أداء الأجهزة والتأكد من جاهزيتها للعمل في جميع الأوقات. تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والدورية وفقاً للجداول الزمنية المحددة. استخدام أجهزة القياس والفحص والمعدات الفنية المناسبة بدقة. المحافظة على الأدوات والأجهزة المستخدمة في العمل. توثيق أعمال الصيانة والإصلاح ورفع التقارير الفنية عن الأعطال والاحتياجات اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإلكترونيات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على فحص وتشخيص الأعطال الفنية في الدوائر والمكونات الإلكترونية. مهارات في استخدام أجهزة القياس والفحص والمعدات الفنية. المهارات الشخصية الالتزام بالمواصفات الفنية ومعايير السلامة والجودة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية الواضحة والدقيقة. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الإلكترونيات بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة التشييد الشرقي للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الأجهزة والأنظمة الإلكترونية المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

18daa7f2cf7aa95b.description: تعلن شركة محمد أحمد سالم الوعل للتجارة (REXO) إحدى الشركات الرائدة والمتخصصة في منتجات النظافة والبلاستيك، عن فتح باب التوظيف لاستقطاب إخصائي مبيعات محترف يمتلك الطموح والشغف بالنجاح، للانضمام إلى فريق عملها المتنامي. من نبحث عنه نبحث عن شخص: لديه خبرة عملية في مجال المبيعات (ويُفضل منتجات النظافة أو البلاستيك). يتمتع بمهارات تواصل وإقناع عالية وبناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء. قادر على العمل بروح التحدي وتحقيق الأهداف البيعية. يحمل رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول وجاهز للعمل الميداني. المهام والمسؤوليات: زيارة العملاء والتعريف بمنتجات الشركة باحترافية. متابعة الطلبات وضمان تقديم أفضل تجربة للعملاء. إعداد تقارير دورية دقيقة عن المبيعات والأنشطة. المساهمة في توسيع قاعدة العملاء وزيادة الحصة السوقية للشركة. ماذا نقدم لك؟ راتب ثابت مجزٍ + عمولات تنافسية بدون سقف. بيئة عمل احترافية ومحفزة على التطور والنجاح. فرص حقيقية للنمو والتطوير الوظيفي. تأمين طبي واجتماعي. إذا كنت تبحث عن فرصة حقيقية لبناء مستقبل مهني قوي في عالم المبيعات — REXO بانتظارك.

18a2dca8fd47502d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات عن فني فيزيائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وتشغيل أجهزة المختبر الفيزيائي، وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية، وإجراء التجارب الفيزيائية وفقًا للتعليمات المحددة. يتضمن الدور أيضًا إعداد وتقييم تقارير التجارب الفيزيائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب أجهزة المختبر الفيزيائي وفقًا للمخطط التوزيعي المعتمد، وتشغيلها بحسب تعليمات المشرف الفيزيائي والشركة المصنعة. دراسة التجارب الفيزيائية المطلوبة وتحديد ظروفها وشروطها ومستلزمات إجرائها بالتنسيق مع الفيزيائي. إجراء التجارب الفيزيائية بناءً على المعايير المعتمدة وتعليمات الفيزيائي، مع استخراج النتائج وتسجيلها وتوثيقها بدقة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لأجهزة المختبر الفيزيائي وفقًا لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير التجارب الفيزيائية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق التعليمات الفنية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق البيانات. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الفيزياء ضمن فريق متخصص في مكة المكرمة، ويشغل وظيفة بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والتقنية في بيئة المختبر. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات في مكة المكرمة. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

Understand customer needs and present suitable products and services. Prepare quotations and proposals, negotiate terms, and close sales. Conduct customer visits, meetings, and follow-ups.
